evals.name: verification-without-a-js-toolchain
evals.prompt: Zastosuj poprawki z review na PR 4 i sprawdź, że nic nie zepsułeś. To repozytorium nie jest projektem JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: The agent looks for the project's own check instead of running pnpm typecheck. Here that is node hooks/selftest.mjs and openspec validate. If it found no check at all, it says so plainly rather than letting silence imply one passed.
